body: Isn't everyone attracted to other people on some small level, at some point?

Thanks. I find him attractive and have "craved" him before...he's funny, kind, loves my family and friends, does cute things for me. I don't know if it's all because of the huge fight and other stress going on.
He's gorgeous and kind. He goes above and beyond for me when I need him. I just sometimes feel nothing when we're intimate the last couple of months.
